create_function_query: create a function that sends a chat completion request to the Together AI API via Hugging Face router
run_query_chat_completion: run the query function to send a user message and retrieve a model response from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
build_request_with_headers: build an authenticated HTTP POST request with a Bearer token header to the Hugging Face v1 chat completions endpoint
test_query_payload: test the query function with a messages payload containing a user role and a model name
summarize_response_json: summarize the JSON response from the API call and extract the assistant message from choices
